selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: encrypted volume auto-unlocked and auto-mounted without manual action, data intact

selected_evidence.summary: Confirmed /etc/crypttab and /etc/fstab entries persisted post-reboot, secure-loop.service is enabled, and the keyfile/backing image retain root-only permissions (400/600).

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: install cryptsetup =="
sudo -n yum install -y cryptsetup >/tmp/yum.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 /tmp/yum.log; exit 1; }
rpm -q cryptsetup

echo "== STEP 2: create backing image file =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/secure-vol /etc/luks
sudo -n fallocate -l 2G /var/lib/secure-vol/secure.img || sudo -n dd if=/dev/zero of=/var/lib/secure-vol/secure.img bs=1M count=2048
sudo -n chmod 600 /var/lib/secure-vol/secure.img
ls -lh /var/lib/secure-vol/secure.img

echo "== STEP 3: generate keyfile =="
sudo -n dd if=/dev/urandom of=/etc/luks/secure.key bs=512 count=4 status=none
sudo -n chmod 400 /etc/luks/secure.key
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/luks/secure.key
ls -l /etc/luks/secure.key

echo "== STEP 4: attach loop device (loop10) =="
sudo -n losetup -d /dev/loop10 2>/dev/null || true
sudo -n losetup /dev/loop10 /var/lib/secure-vol/secure.img
sudo -n losetup -a | grep loop10

echo "== STEP 5: luksFormat =="
sudo -n cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --type luks2 /dev/loop10 /etc/luks/secure.key
sudo -n cryptsetup luksDump /dev/loop10 | head -20

echo "== STEP 6: open, mkfs, close =="
sudo -n cryptsetup open --key-file /etc/luks/secure.key /dev/loop10 secure
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f /dev/mapper/secure
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/secure
sudo -n mount /dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure
sudo -n sh -c 'echo hello-from-setup > /srv/secure/marker.txt'
df -h /srv/secure
sudo -n umount /srv/secure
sudo -n cryptsetup close secure
sudo -n losetup -d /dev/loop10

echo "== STEP 7: systemd unit to attach loop at boot before cryptsetup =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/secure-loop.service >/dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop device for encrypted /srv/secure volume
DefaultDependencies=no
After=local-fs-pre.target
Requires=local-fs-pre.target
Before=systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service cryptsetup.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStartPre=/sbin/losetup -d /dev/loop10
ExecStart=/sbin/losetup /dev/loop10 /var/lib/secure-vol/secure.img
ExecStop=/sbin/losetup -d /dev/loop10

[Install]
WantedBy=cryptsetup.target
UNIT

echo "fix ExecStartPre to not fail if loop already detached"
sudo -n sed -i 's#^ExecStartPre=/sbin/losetup -d /dev/loop10#ExecStartPre=-/sbin/losetup -d /dev/loop10#' /etc/systemd/system/secure-loop.service
cat /etc/systemd/system/secure-loop.service

echo "== STEP 8: crypttab entry =="
sudo -n cp /etc/crypttab /etc/crypttab.bak 2>/dev/null || sudo -n touch /etc/crypttab
grep -q '^secure ' /etc/crypttab 2>/dev/null && sudo -n sed -i '/^secure /d' /etc/crypttab
echo "secure /dev/loop10 /etc/luks/secure.key luks" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/crypttab
cat /etc/crypttab

echo "== STEP 9: fstab entry =="
sudo -n cp /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak
grep -q '/srv/secure' /etc/fstab || echo "/dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure xfs defaults 0 2" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab

echo "== STEP 10: reload systemd, enable unit, regenerate cryptsetup units =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable secure-loop.service
sudo -n systemctl status secure-loop.service --no-pager || true

echo "== STEP 11: test full chain live (without reboot) =="
sudo -n systemctl start secure-loop.service
sudo -n systemctl status secure-loop.service --no-pager
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl start systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service
sudo -n systemctl status systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service --no-pager
ls -l /dev/mapper/secure
sudo -n mount /srv/secure || sudo -n mount -a
mount | grep /srv/secure
cat /srv/secure/marker.txt
df -h /srv/secure

echo "== DONE =="
